subject: Urgent: Helios AI renewal concession — exec approval requested
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@heliosai.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal quote and outage credit request

Hi Lauren,

We received the renewal notice and pushed it internally, but there are two sticking points from procurement: the downtime we experienced in April (we lost ~18 hours of inference capacity) and a pricing increase in the new quote. Our CFO is asking for a one-time operational credit and a term that lets us lock current unit pricing for at least 6 months.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) apply a credit for the outage, 2) hold current per-token pricing for 6 months or propose an alternative, and 3) consider a shorter term increase (annual vs multiyear) with a lower uplift?

Attached is our usage summary for Q2 for reference.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Platform Engineering
Helios AI

Attachment: Helios_Q2_usage_report.xlsx (spreadsheet, 92KB)
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@heliosai.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com,priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote and outage credit request

Hi Elena — thanks for the packet and the candid note. I’m sorry Helios hit the outage in April; we did root cause work and shared the postmortem with your team but I understand the business impact.

Short answer: we can do something but need quick internal alignment. Currently on the table from my side:
- One-time operational credit to make Helios whole for April (range to propose: $50k–$80k)
- Price hold for 6 months on current token tiers, after which the new rate would apply
- Option to add a 6-month premium support bundle (SLA window, dedicated escalation channel) at no additional charge for the first 6 months instead of a deeper % discount

I’m looping in Marcus and Priyom (deal desk) to get a recommended concession package and to route for exec sign-off if needed. I’ve attached our latest renewal quote (RFD_renewal_quote_v3.pdf). Please let me know if Helios would prefer a straight credit vs. invoice adjustment.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RFD_renewal_quote_v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com,neha_kapoor@redwood.com,marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal quote and outage credit request — recommended package

Lauren — looked into Helios usage and outage impact. High level recommendation:
- Approve a one-time operational credit of $60,000 (applied across first two invoices) — covers outage impact and shows good faith
- Price hold for 6 months on current tiers, with a 12% net uplift applied thereafter (instead of the quoted 18%)
- Add a free 6-month premium support bundle (SLA add-on) — included as a service amendment rather than a perpetual discount

Rationale: preserves deal economics but gives clear non-recurring remediation. If the customer insists on a larger discount instead of a credit, we can consider up to 15% discount but that needs VP approval (Vivek). Also, any term reset beyond 6 months (e.g., extend to 12 months at older pricing) would erode the projected ARR and needs finance sign-off.

Requesting Vivek’s exec sign-off on the above or guidance on adjustments. If Vivek signs off, Legal should be routed to add an amendment (attached: amendment_draft_for_legal.docx) and Finance should be instructed to apply the credit scheduling.

Thanks,
Priyom
Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com,neha_kapoor@redwood.com,marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Need emergency sign-off: Helios AI renewal concession request (deal RWD-2028-2274)

Vivek — quick summary and ask:

- Customer: Helios AI (Platform / inference-heavy, ~2.4M tokens/month)
- Renewal value: $1.1M ARR (annualized) if we keep the term; risk of churn if we don’t soften pricing
- Incident: April outage (~18 hours) — Helios seeks remediation and a short price hold
- Proposed concession (Priyom recommends): $60k one-time credit + 6-month price hold + 6-month premium support bundle

Key asks:
1) Exec approval to apply the $60k credit and the 6-month price hold (we’ll record as a one-time concession)
2) Approve the SLA premium support add-on free for the first 6 months
3) If approved, direction to Legal (attach amendment_draft_for_legal.docx) and Finance to schedule credit across invoices

Attachments for context: risk_analysis_short.docx, customer_emails.pdf (customer complaint thread)

We need a yes/no today to keep the renewal momentum — Helios has procurement calls scheduled Thurs afternoon PT.

- Lauren
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: risk_analysis_short.docx (docx, 48KB)
Attachment: customer_emails.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com,neha_kapoor@redwood.com,marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need emergency sign-off: Helios AI renewal concession request (deal RWD-2028-2274)

Thanks for the concise summary, Lauren. I’ve reviewed the usage, the April postmortem, and Priyom’s recommendation. I approve a constrained concession with the following conditions:

- Approve a one-time credit of $60,000 to be applied across the first two invoices following renewal.
- Approve a 12% price hold for 6 months; after that, the new quoted pricing applies.
- Approve a 6-month premium support SLA add-on at no charge (must be an explicit amendment, not a product-level change).
- No additional term resets beyond a 6-month price hold — we will not extend the legacy pricing longer than 6 months.

Operational notes: Legal to prepare an amendment that references RWD-2028-2274 and documents the credit schedule (attachment: amendment_draft_for_legal.docx). Finance to apply the credit across two invoices as described. CS (Marcus) must run a platform health check and provide a 30/60/90 remediation plan to Helios; results to be reviewed by me.

Lauren — proceed to confirm with Helios and route legal/finance. If Helios pushes for a higher discount instead of the credit, bring back for an escalated approval; do not commit above 15% without CFO approval.

— Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
